nb821640dac.summary: Experts warn that global warming, rather than climate policy, is bad for business in Europe. The summer's extreme heat is cited as the source of the economic damage.
nb821640dac.why: Heat waves reduce labour productivity, energy demand and agricultural output, which can weigh on economic growth.

n22f6e30a2d.summary: A coordinated Russian attack overnight destroyed warehouses and sorting centres run by Epicentr, Nova Poshta, Silpo and Novus. At least 10 people were killed, according to the report.
n22f6e30a2d.why: Epicentr, Nova Poshta, Silpo and Novus are major Ukrainian retail and logistics operators, so damage to their hubs disrupts distribution across the country.

n08e43f8183.headline: Lineage Q2 Earnings Call Highlights
n08e43f8183.summary: Lineage reported second-quarter results that exceeded internal expectations and consensus estimates, with adjusted EBITDA of about $320 million. Warehouse occupancy improved and cost controls offset trade-related volume pressure.
n08e43f8183.why: Lineage is a large temperature-controlled warehouse operator, so its occupancy and cost trends indicate demand across food and cold-storage logistics.

n01226f2efd.headline: Ukrainian Drone Barrage Sets Wildberries Sortation Center in Tula Region Ablaze
n01226f2efd.summary: Ukrainian drones struck a Wildberries sortation center in the Tula region, the online retailer and local officials said, with at least one person injured. The attack is the latest hit on Russian logistics infrastructure.
n01226f2efd.why: Wildberries is one of Russia's largest online marketplaces, so disruption to its fulfilment network affects a major domestic e-commerce operator. Attacks on logistics sites can also weigh on Russian retail and supply chains.

n8c41fd08b7.headline: Iran and the US say a Strait of Hormuz deal is close, but one or both would have to back down
n8c41fd08b7.summary: Iran said it is in the final stage of drafting an agreement with Oman over the Strait of Hormuz, and Iran and the US say a deal is close. One or both sides would have to back down.
n8c41fd08b7.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly a fifth of global seaborne oil, so any arrangement governing passage through it directly affects crude supply and freight costs. Its security is a core driver of energy prices.
n8c41fd08b7.why_moved: Reports that a Hormuz deal is close bear on expected Gulf oil shipping security, which is a key driver of crude prices.

n1d13d3d4bd.headline: Nikon Lost Its Viltrox Lawsuit and Sony to Buy Tamron? | The PetaPixel Podcast
n1d13d3d4bd.summary: A PetaPixel podcast discusses Sony's bid to buy Tamron and Nikon's loss to Viltrox in a Chinese court over a lawsuit.
n1d13d3d4bd.why: Sony and Nikon are major camera makers, and Tamron is a Japanese maker of third-party lenses, so consolidation affects the camera equipment market.

n6647658de8.headline: US and Iran having 'very good discussions', Trump says
n6647658de8.summary: Donald Trump said the US and Iran held positive all-day talks, while claiming control over the Strait of Hormuz. The remainder of the description is truncated in the source.
n6647658de8.why: US-Iran diplomacy affects Gulf security and the risk premium on oil shipped through the Strait of Hormuz.

n5630beeeba.headline: Solar for all to boost energy transition
n5630beeeba.summary: Climate Minister Chris Bowen is backing the Small-scale Renewable Energy Scheme. A 20 per cent discount on medium-sized solar systems for warehouses, offices, retail stores and farm sheds is planned.
n5630beeeba.why: Government incentives for solar installations influence demand for solar equipment and installers. They are a core tool of Australia's energy transition policy.

ncbadd76f3c.headline: Australians defy RBA and continue to spend
ncbadd76f3c.summary: Rate hikes are off the agenda after lower-than-expected trimmed-mean inflation, but the RBA remains concerned about consumer spending. Household spending continues despite three hikes this year and low sentiment.
ncbadd76f3c.why: Household spending drives most of Australia's economic activity, so it heavily influences the central bank's rate path.

nf67b566aaa.headline: MARGINALIA: Six Ships Through Hormuz

nf67b566aaa.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries a large share of the world's seaborne oil, so shipping disruptions there move crude markets. Transit counts are watched as an indicator of Gulf supply risk.

n04e86a294b.headline: Rival plan to close Labor's 'widow tax' loophole sooner
n04e86a294b.summary: A rival plan would close Labor's so-called widow tax loophole sooner. Under the draft laws, Australians who inherit an investment property from a partner would keep access to negative gearing.
n04e86a294b.why: Negative gearing lets investors deduct property losses against other income, so changes to its treatment affect the Australian property market.

n3d457db804.headline: Indonesia extends food aid and holiday travel discounts for late 2026
n3d457db804.summary: Indonesia will continue several strategic programmes into late 2026, including food aid and holiday travel discounts, according to Coordinating Minister for Economic Affairs Airlangga Hartarto.
n3d457db804.why: Food aid and consumer subsidies affect household spending and government budget commitments in Indonesia, Southeast Asia's largest economy.

n08a06e92e0.headline: Iran and the U.S. say a Strait of Hormuz deal is close, but one or both would have to back down
n08a06e92e0.summary: Iran and the US say a deal on the Strait of Hormuz is close, though one or both would have to back down. Closure of the strait has pushed up fuel and basic goods prices.
n08a06e92e0.why: The Strait of Hormuz carries roughly a fifth of global oil and LNG flows, so any change in its status affects energy prices worldwide.
n08a06e92e0.why_moved: A possible deal to reopen the strait would reduce the supply risk that has lifted energy prices.

ndb5914c7b5.headline: Stocks rise on Wall Street and add to their records as oil prices hold steady
ndb5914c7b5.summary: US stocks rose in morning trading and added to their records as oil prices held steady, according to AP. Gains extended the market's run of highs.

n2ecf867358.summary: UK clothing and homeware retailer Next lifted its profit outlook again, citing sales growth from its alternative brands and strong online sales during a sweltering summer.
